title: Warm Roasted American Sirloin Steak Tips Skillet
description: A comforting American dish featuring roasted sirloin steak tips, this skillet is perfect for a weeknight dinner. It is made with sashimi-cut steak tips and is satvik-friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the steak tips with olive oil, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, black pepper, and paprika until they are evenly coated.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and add the steak tips, cooking for 2-3 minutes per side.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and roast for 10-12 minutes, or until the steak tips reach an internal temperature of 130 degrees Fahrenheit.
While the steak tips are cooking, add the roasted bell peppers and onions to the skillet.
Once the steak tips are cooked, remove the skillet from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Serve the steak tips and roasted vegetables hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
